description: This Java class defines the ConceptAttribute entity in the OpenMRS project, extending BaseAttribute and implementing Attribute interface, with getters and setters for concept attribute ID and associated concept.

classes.name: ConceptAttribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute of a concept with auditing capabilities, linking to Concept and ConceptAttributeType, extending BaseAttribute.

methods.name: getConceptAttributeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this ConceptAttribute.

methods.name: setConceptAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this ConceptAttribute.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this ConceptAttribute.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID for this ConceptAttribute.
